assessment: In this fascinating study, the authors explore the cellular and molecular bases of phototaxis in Cynaobacteria. It is shown that phototaxis is a highly efficient Spatio-temporal response involving "within a pole regulation" of retractile Type-IV pili. This unique regulation involves the interplay of three possible photoreceptors that regulate the intracellular concentration of c-di-GMP in response to green to blue light transitions.
